assumptions: The cut-off phrase "with a heart-shaped" is a heart-shaped rose window / emblem on the keep gate tower plus heart-shaped topiary by the drawbridge.
Per-instance color modulates the stock toon/lambert base color, so one cube batch can draw beige stone, brown wood and dark gate with different tints.
Compute modules receive a host time/step uniform for the flutter animation; init stages place all static instances deterministically.
design.cameraAndTiming: Slow orbital film, eye ~[22,14,26] to target [0,5,0], gentle 30s drift around front three-quarter view showing hill, gate/drawbridge and heart window; fov 55.
design.intent: A toon-shaded fairytale castle on a grassy hill: round towers with cone roofs, crenellated walls, small drawbridge and fluttering pennants, with a heart-shaped window/emblem.
design.interpretation: The request is truncated after "heart-shaped"; read as a heart-shaped pink window/emblem centered over the gate, echoed by two heart-pink topiaries flanking the drawbridge.
design.motion: Static castle and hill; five triangular pennants on tower roofs skew/scale in a traveling wave from a fixedStep compute stage; sky gradient is static, camera slowly orbits.
resourceFlow: initMain (init) writes hillBuf, stoneBuf, towerBuf, roofBuf static instance14 records
initFlags (init) writes flagBuf base pennant transforms
flutterFlags (fixedStep) rewrites flagBuf each step with wave skew for flutter
batchHill/batchStone/batchTower/batchRoof draw static buffers; batchFlag draws animated flagBuf
sky fullscreen draws gradient backdrop; film post chain grades final image
successCriteria: Grassy green hill mound under castle, sky behind
Toon-shaded beige castle with 4 round towers plus central keep
Red/pink cone roofs on every tower
Crenellated top edges on walls and towers
Brown drawbridge plus dark gate arch at front
Five fluttering pink pennants on roof tips
Pink heart-shaped window/emblem over gate visible in one frame

techniques.purpose: Instanced plain batches with 14-float records for hill, cubes, cylinders, cones and flags.
Toon shading for stone and roofs, lambert for grass, emissive for pennants/heart.
Warm sun plus ambient to shade toon steps and lambert hill.
Fairytale film look: bloom, color grade, tonemap, vignette.

unresolved: The noun after "heart-shaped" was cut off; chose heart window + topiaries — no adapter for true heart mesh.
